release_notes: Media Experiment Ledger Studio 1.0.0-rc.6 completes the optional accelerator engine bundle milestone. The universal CPU engine remains embedded and usable, while signed DirectML, CoreML and CUDA engine profiles can be verified, installed, activated, rolled back or quarantined independently. Bundle admission is fail-closed: Ed25519 identity, canonical manifest fields, every file SHA-256 and size, platform and architecture, Studio compatibility, ONNX Runtime version, provider registration and CUDA/cuDNN/driver requirements are checked before activation. Active engine pointers are replaced atomically, warm workers are destroyed during maintenance, failed bundles are isolated, and each build carries an SPDX SBOM, notices and native-library inventory.
features: Universal packages permanently retain the CPU-capable base engine
Typed optional DirectML, CoreML and CUDA runtime profiles
Per-file SHA-256, size and safe-relative-path verification
Platform, architecture, Studio version and operating-system compatibility gates
CUDA runtime, cuDNN and minimum NVIDIA driver validation
Post-install packaged provider inventory self-test before activation
Atomic installation and active runtime pointer replacement
Bounded activation history and one-click rollback
Warm workers and provider inventory caches reset on runtime changes
Hardware Runtime Center bundle install, activate, rollback, quarantine and remove controls
Per-bundle SPDX SBOM, third-party notices and native-library inventory
Four-profile DirectML, CoreML arm64/x64 and CUDA bundle build matrix
